donorReadme: - Source: USGS/NASA Callisto Voyager-Galileo SSI global mosaic 1km
- License: public domain as a USGS/NASA planetary data product
- Purpose: replace the earlier non-2:1 Callisto image with an authoritative simple-cylindrical global map
- Processing: converted from the 15138x7569 8-bit source mosaic to `2048x1024` JPEG

source.licence: public domain as a USGS/NASA planetary data product

coordinates.placement: latLonToXYZ in the donor src/entities/hotspot.ts, on Three.js SphereGeometry UVs
coordinates.longitudeDegrees: exactly as stored in features.json, placed by latLonToXYZ whatever the range; the donor stores values already in its own marker frame (see longitudeRange, markerLongitudeFromSource and donorReadmeNote)
coordinates.position: [radius * sin(phi) * sin(theta), radius * cos(phi), radius * sin(phi) * cos(theta)]
coordinates.conventionNote: donor: remapped into east-positive displayed globe coordinates; formula not stated
coordinates.donorReadmeNote: - The current Callisto release uses the USGS/NASA global mosaic at `2K`; source feature coordinates were checked against the IAU/USGS planetographic, positive-west, 0-360 system, then remapped into the app's east-positive displayed globe coordinates for `data/callisto-features.json`.
